rows.headline: Revenue fell 5.2% in August while late deliveries rose to 6.2%
rows.summary: August 2018 brought 6,512 orders and R$ 1,003,308 in revenue, down 5.2% from July's R$ 1,058,728. Late deliveries rose to 6.2% from 3.4%, while the average review score held at 4.26. In the tagged review sample, Not delivered was the costliest complaint with 5 complaints (4 in July), followed by Damaged / defective with 4 (3 in July). The monthly sample is small, so Logistics and Seller packaging should treat this as an early warning rather than a firm trend.
rows.action_1: Ask Logistics to investigate why late deliveries rose from 3.4% to 6.2% and chase every order not yet delivered.
rows.action_2: Ask Seller packaging to review the damaged-item cases with the sellers involved and tighten packaging rules.
rows.action_3: Ask Seller fulfilment to make sure multi-item orders ship complete, or tell customers when items arrive separately.
